## Combo 1-1742-1786-6282
Cards: Ketramose, the New Dawn + Containment Construct + Skirge Familiar + Queza, Augur of Agonies
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 19 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite lifeloss; Near-infinite black mana; Exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn; Near-infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite rummaging; Infinite self-discard triggers; Infinite draw triggers
Start: Ketramose, the New Dawn (battlefield); Containment Construct (battlefield); Skirge Familiar (battlefield); Queza, Augur of Agonies (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have a card in hand.
  Your life total is at least 2.
Steps: Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
  Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
  Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
  Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
  Repeat.

## Combo 1-1786-6282
Cards: Ketramose, the New Dawn + Containment Construct + Queza, Augur of Agonies
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 32 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite lifeloss; Near-infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite rummaging; Infinite self-discard triggers; Infinite draw triggers
Start: Ketramose, the New Dawn (battlefield); Containment Construct (battlefield); Queza, Augur of Agonies (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
  You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
Steps: Proceed to your next cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
  Containment Construct triggers for each card discarded this way. Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card.
  Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
  Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
  Resolve all remaining Containment Construct abilities, if applicable, choosing not to exile anything.
  Once the stack has emptied and all players pass priority, you will still be in the cleanup step and thus need to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
  Repeat from step 2.

Start: Aminatou, the Fateshifter (battlefield: must be your commander; with three loyalty counters on it); The Chain Veil (battlefield); Palinchron (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
Steps: Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
  Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an additional activation of planeswalkers' loyalty abilities until end of turn.
  Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking The Chain Veil.
  Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Palinchron.
  When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
  Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
  Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an additional activation of planeswalkers' loyalty abilities until end of turn.
  Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Palinchron and killing Aminatou due to it having zero loyalty, causing it to be returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
  When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
  Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
  Cast Aminatou from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B} plus commander tax.
  Repeat steps 2 through 7 one additional time.
  Activate Aminatou's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to draw a card and then put a card on top of your library.
  Repeat step 13 until the number of loyalty counters on Aminatou is equal to the number of activations of Aminatou's abilities you have remaining this turn.
  Repeat steps 4 through 6 until Aminatou dies due to it having zero loyalty and is returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
  Repeat from step 11.
Notes: The combo is written to assume that Aminatou has a commander tax of 0, and that The Chain Veil has not been activated during the current turn. If either of these is not true, the costs of the combo may change accordingly.

## Combo 390-624-670-1619
Cards: Sefris of the Hidden Ways + Radiant Solar + Hulking Metamorph + Phantasmal Image
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 5 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite lifeloss for all players; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Radiant Solar (battlefield); Hulking Metamorph (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar); Phantasmal Image (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar)
Prerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
  You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
Steps: Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Hulking Metamorph and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
  Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Color identity: WUB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {2}{U}
Produces: Near-infinite lifeloss for all players; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Radiant Solar (battlefield); Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Wormfang Drake (hand); Ravenloft Adventurer (hand)
Prerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
Steps: Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
  Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Ravenloft Adventurer.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
  When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from exile to the battlefield.
  When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
  Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
  Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Ravenloft Adventurer.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
  Repeat from step 5.

## Combo 465-1734-3991
Cards: Wormfang Drake + Fiend Hunter + Faceless Butcher
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 15 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Fiend Hunter (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Faceless Butcher (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
  When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Steps: Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
  When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

## Combo 465-3839-3991
Cards: Wormfang Drake + Changeling Hero + Faceless Butcher
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 3 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Hero (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Faceless Butcher (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
  When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Start: Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Hero (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Hostage Taker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
  When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Start: Dack Fayden, Helping Hand (hand); Preston, the Vanisher (hand); Radiant Solar (hand); Scroll Rack (battlefield); Hostage Taker (hand)
Steps: Activate Scroll Rack by paying {1} and tapping it, exchanging as many cards as you choose from your hand with an equal number from the top of your library, ensuring Radiant Solar, Preston the Vanisher, and Hostage Taker will be the creatures encountered by Dack. (Note: if those three are the only creature cards in your library, most likely due to deck construction, you may omit this step.)
  Cast Dack Fayden by paying {4}{W}{W}.
  When Dack enters, its ETB triggers, putting the three creatures mentioned into play and giving one to each opponent.
  Hostage Taker triggers once, Preston triggers twice, and Radiant Solar triggers three times. Choose Preston as the target for Hostage Taker.
  Resolve Hostage Taker's trigger, exiling the Preston you gave away until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Hostage Taker.

  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Radiant Solar. It triggers, giving you a fourth "venture into the dungeon" trigger.
  Resolve three venture triggers, progressing through the Tomb of Annihilation until you reach the Sandfall Cell and losing 3 life in the process (reduced to 1 if you have a card available to discard).
  Sacrifice the Illusion Hostage Taker to the Sandfall Cell, returning the original Hostage Taker to the battlefield.
  Hostage Taker, Preston, and each Radiant Solar you control all trigger.
  Resolve Hostage Taker's trigger, exiling the nontoken Radiant Solar until it leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve Preston's trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Hostage Taker.
  The Illusion Hostage Taker triggers, exiling the original and returning Radiant Solar to the battlefield.
  Preston, the nontoken Radiant Solar, and each Illusion copy of Radiant Solar all trigger.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an additional Illusion copy of Radiant Solar.
  The Illusion of Radiant Solar triggers, giving you an additional "venture into the dungeon" trigger.
  Resolve four venture triggers, completing and re-entering the Tomb of Annihilation. Progress to the Sandfall Cell, losing 3 life in the process (reduced to 1 if you have a card available to discard).
  Repeat steps 10 through 18. Now that you have more than one token copy of Radiant Solar, each iteration will result in an increasing number of venture triggers in excess of the four needed to perform the loop. 
  For each group of four excess venture triggers, you may alternate between the Tomb of Annihilation and the Lost Mine of Phandelver. Due to the Veils of Fear room and the Dark Pool room, this will offset the life loss and discard from the Tomb while accelerating your opponents' life loss.

Produces: Near-infinite lifeloss for all players; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Radiant Solar (battlefield); Evil Twin (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar); Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar)
Prerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
  You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
Steps: Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Evil Twin each trigger.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
  Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

  You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
Steps: Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Chameleon each trigger.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
  Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

  When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
  Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
  Repeat.
Notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

Steps: Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Pirated Copy each trigger.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
  Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Color identity: WUB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 38 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}{W}{W}
Produces: Near-infinite lifeloss for all players; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Radiant Solar (battlefield); Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Werefox Bodyguard (hand); Seasoned Dungeoneer (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
Steps: Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
  When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
  Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Seasoned Dungeoneer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
  Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Seasoned Dungeoneer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
  When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
  Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
  Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Seasoned Dungeoneer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
  Repeat from step 5.

Start: Dack Fayden, Helping Hand (hand); Preston, the Vanisher (hand); Radiant Solar (hand); Penance (battlefield); Hostage Taker (hand)
Steps: Activate Penance by putting a card from your hand on top of your library, preventing the next instance of damage from a black or red source of your choosing. Repeat for each card you wish to put on top, ensuring Radiant Solar, Preston the Vanisher, and Hostage Taker will be the creatures encountered by Dack. (Note: if those three are the only creature cards in your library, most likely due to deck construction, you may omit this step.)
  Cast Dack Fayden by paying {4}{W}{W}.
  When Dack enters, its ETB triggers, putting the three creatures mentioned into play and giving one to each opponent.
  Hostage Taker triggers once, Preston triggers twice, and Radiant Solar triggers three times. Choose Preston as the target for Hostage Taker.
  Resolve Hostage Taker's trigger, exiling the Preston you gave away until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Hostage Taker.
  The Illusion Hostage Taker triggers, exiling the original and returning Preston to the battlefield under your control.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Radiant Solar. It triggers, giving you a fourth "venture into the dungeon" trigger.
  Resolve three venture triggers, progressing through the Tomb of Annihilation until you reach the Sandfall Cell and losing 3 life in the process (reduced to 1 if you have a card available to discard).
  Sacrifice the Illusion Hostage Taker to the Sandfall Cell, returning the original Hostage Taker to the battlefield.
  Hostage Taker, Preston, and each Radiant Solar you control all trigger.
  Resolve Hostage Taker's trigger, exiling the nontoken Radiant Solar until it leaves the battlefield.
  Resolve Preston's trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Hostage Taker.

Requires: Creature with Persist or Undying (battlefield)
Start: Luminous Broodmoth (battlefield); Grimgrin, Corpse-Born (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
  When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
  Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
  Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
  Repeat.
Notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

  Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
